topic: Ordering Lunch Catering for the Office

script.title: ORDERING OFFICE LUNCH
script.scene_zh: 外燴公司 · 預訂午餐
script.story_hook: Forty lunches for one busy Friday meeting.
script.intro_zh: 四十份午餐，只為一場忙碌的週五會議。
script.welcome_en: Hi, welcome to today's catering call. Listen for food order phrases.
script.welcome_zh: 嗨，歡迎來到今天的外燴預訂場景。留意點餐的實用句型。
script.outro: And that's forty lunches all sorted. Listen again and try it out loud.
script.outro_zh: 四十份午餐就這樣安排妥當。再聽一次，大聲跟著說說看。
script.practice_intro_en: Now let's repeat each line together.
script.practice_intro_zh: 現在我們一起逐句跟讀。
script.title_quote: half of them don't eat meat
script.char_a_description: a middle-aged man in his thirties with short neat dark hair and a full trimmed beard, black-rimmed glasses, an olive green button-down shirt, and a stocky build
script.char_b_description: a cheerful young woman in her early twenties with blonde hair tied in a braided crown, a white apron over a black tee, a clipboard in hand, and a curvy build

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hi, I'd like to order lunch for our office.
dialogue.phonetic: /haɪ aɪd laɪk tə ˈɔɹdɚ lʌntʃ fɚ ɑɹ ˈɔfəs/
dialogue.zh: 嗨，我想替辦公室訂午餐。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Great, happy to help, roughly how many?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡɹeɪt ˈhæpi tə hɛlp ˈɹʌfli haʊ ˈmɛni/
dialogue.zh: 太好了，很樂意幫你，大約幾位？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Um, about forty people, maybe two more.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʌm əˈbaʊt ˈfɔɹti ˈpipəl ˈmeɪbi tu mɔɹ/
dialogue.zh: 嗯，大約四十位，可能再加兩位。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Okay, forty or forty-two, got it noted.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˌoʊˈkeɪ ˈfɔɹti ɔɹ ˈfɔɹti tu ɡɑɾ ɪt ˈnoʊtəd/
dialogue.zh: 好，四十或四十二位，我記下來了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It's for a Friday team meeting.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪts fɚ ə ˈfɹaɪdeɪ tim ˈmitɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 是週五的團隊會議要用的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Nice, do they want a hot meal or cold?
dialogue.phonetic: /naɪs du ðeɪ wɑnt ə hɑt mil ɔɹ koʊld/
dialogue.zh: 不錯，大家要吃熱的還是冷的？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hmm, what do you suggest for a group?
dialogue.phonetic: /həm wʌt du ju səˈdʒɛst fɚ ə ɡɹup/
dialogue.zh: 嗯，這種團體餐你建議什麼？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A hot buffet usually travels and serves best.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə hɑt bʊˈfeɪ ˈjuʒəwəli ˈtɹævəlz ænd sɝvz bɛst/
dialogue.zh: 熱的自助餐通常保溫好、也好分送。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Sounds good, what does that come with?
dialogue.phonetic: /saʊndz ɡʊd wʌt dʌz ðæt kʌm wɪθ/
dialogue.zh: 聽起來不錯，那個方案都附什麼？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Two mains, two sides, and rolls.
dialogue.phonetic: /tu meɪnz tu saɪdz ænd ɹoʊlz/
dialogue.zh: 兩樣主菜、兩樣配菜，還有麵包。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Oh, and what are the main choices?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɑʊ ænd wʌt ɑɹ ðə meɪn ˈtʃɔɪsəz/
dialogue.zh: 噢，那主菜有哪幾種選擇？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We have chicken piccata and a baked ziti.
dialogue.phonetic: /wi hæv ˈtʃɪkən pɪˈkɑtə ænd ə beɪkt ˈziti/
dialogue.zh: 店裡有香煎雞排和焗烤義麵。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Well, half of them don't eat meat.
dialogue.phonetic: /wɛl hæf ʌv ðəm doʊnt it mit/
dialogue.zh: 嗯，我們有一半的人不吃肉。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No problem, we do great veggie trays.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ ˈpɹɑbləm wi du ɡɹeɪt ˈvɛdʒɪ tɹeɪz/
dialogue.zh: 沒問題，蔬食拼盤做得相當好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Perfect, um, what's on a veggie tray?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈpɝfɪkt ʌm wɑts ɑn ə ˈvɛdʒɪ tɹeɪ/
dialogue.zh: 太好了，嗯，那蔬食盤裡有什麼？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Fresh carrots, celery, peppers, and a dip.
dialogue.phonetic: /fɹɛʃ ˈkæɹəts ˈsɛləɹi ˈpɛpɚz ænd ə dɪp/
dialogue.zh: 新鮮紅蘿蔔、芹菜、甜椒，還有沾醬。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That one's always gone first, honestly.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt wʌnz ˈɔlweɪz ɡɑn fɝst ˈɑnəstli/
dialogue.zh: 那個每次都最先見底，說真的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ha, I'll add a second, just in case.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɑ aɪl æd ə ˈsɛkənd dʒʌst ɪn keɪs/
dialogue.zh: 哈，那我再加一盤，以防萬一。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Smart, thank you. Any salad too?
dialogue.phonetic: /smɑɹt θæŋk ju ˈɛni ˈsæləd tu/
dialogue.zh: 聰明，謝謝。要不要再加沙拉？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sure, a garden salad or a coleslaw.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʊɹ ə ˈɡɑɹdən ˈsæləd ɔɹ ə ˈkoʊslɔ/
dialogue.zh: 可以，有田園沙拉或高麗菜沙拉。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Let's do the garden, coleslaw's too heavy.
dialogue.phonetic: /lɛts du ðə ˈɡɑɹdən ˈkoʊslɔz tu ˈhɛvi/
dialogue.zh: 就田園吧，高麗菜太厚重了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good call, it stays light for a meeting.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡʊd kɔl ɪt steɪz laɪt fɚ ə ˈmitɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 選得好，開會吃這個比較輕盈。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Now, the tricky part, we have allergies.
dialogue.phonetic: /naʊ ðə ˈtɹɪki pɑɹt wi hæv ˈælɚdʒiz/
dialogue.zh: 接下來有點麻煩，在座有人有過敏。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Tell me now, I can flag the kitchen.
dialogue.phonetic: /tɛl mi naʊ aɪ kæn flæɡ ðə ˈkɪtʃən/
dialogue.zh: 現在告訴我就好，我能提前跟廚房講。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One guest can't have any nuts at all.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn ɡɛst kænt hæv ˈɛni nʌts æt ɔl/
dialogue.zh: 有位同事完全不能吃堅果。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Understood, I'll keep nuts off every tray.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˌʌndɚˈstʊd aɪl kip nʌts ɔf ˈɛvɹi tɹeɪ/
dialogue.zh: 了解，我會讓每盤都不沾堅果。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: And another is gluten free, is that okay?
dialogue.phonetic: /ænd əˈnʌðɚ ɪz ˈɡlutən fɹi ɪz ðæt ˌoʊˈkeɪ/
dialogue.zh: 還有一位不能吃麩質，這樣可以嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yep, the ziti's out, but cornbread works.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛp ðə ˈzitiz aʊt bʌt ˈkɔɹnˌbɹɛd wɝks/
dialogue.zh: 可以的，焗麵換掉，玉米麵包沒問題。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Oh nice, do you list that on the trays?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɑʊ naɪs du ju lɪst ðæt ɑn ðə tɹeɪz/
dialogue.zh: 噢，會把這些標示在餐盤上嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We label each dish with its allergens.
dialogue.phonetic: /wi ˈleɪbəl itʃ dɪʃ wɪθ ɪts ˈælɚdʒənəz/
dialogue.zh: 每道菜都會貼上過敏原標籤。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That's a relief, saves me explaining.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæts ə ɹɪˈlif seɪvz mi ɪkˈspleɪnɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 真是鬆口氣，省得我一一解釋。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Always, it's on my allergy list.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɔlweɪz ɪts ɑn maɪ ˈælɚdʒi lɪst/
dialogue.zh: 應該的，我都寫在我的過敏名單上。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Speaking of, when can you deliver Friday?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈspikɪŋ ʌv wɛn kæn ju dɪˈlɪvɚ ˈfɹaɪdeɪ/
dialogue.zh: 說到這個，週五幾點能送到？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We have a ten to noon window.
dialogue.phonetic: /wi hæv ə tɛn tə nun ˈwɪndoʊ/
dialogue.zh: 送貨時段抓在十點到中午之間。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hmm, our meeting starts at noon sharp.
dialogue.phonetic: /həm ɑɹ ˈmitɪŋ stɑɹts æt nun ʃɑɹp/
dialogue.zh: 嗯，我這場會議正午準時開始。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then we'll aim for the early side.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn wil eɪm fɚ ði ˈɝli saɪd/
dialogue.zh: 那我就盡量排在早一點的那頭。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Could we make it before eleven thirty?
dialogue.phonetic: /kʊd wi meɪk ɪt bɪˈfɔɹ ɪˈlɛvən ˈθɝɾi/
dialogue.zh: 能不能安排在十一點半之前？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That's tight, but sure, we can do it.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæts taɪt bʌt ʃʊɹ wi kæn du ɪt/
dialogue.zh: 有點趕，不過可以做到。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Really? That takes a big worry off me.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɹɪli ðæt keɪts ə bɪɡ ˈwɝi ɔf mi/
dialogue.zh: 真的嗎？那我就放心多了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ha, that's what we're here for.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɑ ðæts wʌt wɪɹ hɪɹ fɔɹ/
dialogue.zh: 哈，這是分內之事，別客氣。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do we need a table set up for you?
dialogue.phonetic: /du wi nid ə ˈteɪbəl sɛt ʌp fɚ ju/
dialogue.zh: 送來前要先幫你準備一張桌子嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, one long table, please, near the door.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs wʌn lɔŋ ˈteɪbəl pliz nɪɹ ðə dɔɹ/
dialogue.zh: 要的，一張長桌就好，靠近門口。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Got it. And who signs when you arrive?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡɑɾ ɪt ænd hu saɪnz wɛn ju əˈɹaɪv/
dialogue.zh: 記下了。到時候誰來簽收？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Just anyone in the front, they check names.
dialogue.phonetic: /dʒʌst ˈɛniˌwʌn ɪn ðə fɹʌnt ðeɪ tʃɛk neɪmz/
dialogue.zh: 前台任何一位都能簽，會先核對名單。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Okay, what's the damage for all this?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˌoʊˈkeɪ wʌts ðə ˈdæmɪdʒ fɔɹ ɔl ðɪs/
dialogue.zh: 好，那這一切加起來多少錢？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Let me run it, about twelve a head.
dialogue.phonetic: /lɛt mi ɹʌn ɪt əˈbaʊt twɛlv ə hɛd/
dialogue.zh: 讓我算一下，大約每位十二塊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So close to five hundred total then?
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ kloʊs tə faɪv ˈhʌndɹəd ˈtoʊɾəl ðɛn/
dialogue.zh: 這樣加起來接近五百塊了嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Four ninety, with the extra veggie tray.
dialogue.phonetic: /fɔɹ ˈnaɪnti wɪð ði ˈɛkstrə ˈvɛdʒɪ tɹeɪ/
dialogue.zh: 四百九十，含多出來那盤蔬食。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That's fair. Can I pay by invoice?
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæts fɛɹ kæn aɪ peɪ baɪ ˈɪnvɔɪs/
dialogue.zh: 合理。可以用請款單付款嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sure, we'll bill your office within a week.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʊɹ wil bɪl jɔɹ ˈɔfəs wɪˈðɪn ə wik/
dialogue.zh: 當然，一週內把帳單寄到貴辦公室。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Great, and can I reach you if plans shift?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡɹeɪt ænd kæn aɪ ɹitʃ ju ɪf plænz ʃɪft/
dialogue.zh: 太好了，那計畫若有變，還能找你嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Of course, my number's on the confirmation.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʌv kɔɹs maɪ ˈnʌmbɚz ɑn ðə ˌkɑnfɚˈmeɪʃən/
dialogue.zh: 當然，我的電話就寫在確認單上。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Wonderful. Um, are plates and cups included?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈwʌndɚfʌl ʌm ɑɹ pleɪts ænd kʌps ɪnˈkludəd/
dialogue.zh: 棒極了。嗯，餐盤和杯子都有附嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, with napkins, we pack it all.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs wɪθ ˈnæpkɪnz wi pæk ɪt ɔl/
dialogue.zh: 都有，還附餐巾紙，全部打包好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Perfect, I really think that covers it.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈpɝfɪkt aɪ ˈɹɪli θɪŋk ðæt ˈkʌvɚz ɪt/
dialogue.zh: 完美，我想這樣就萬事齊備了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I'll send a written recap by tonight.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪl sɛnd ə ˈɹɪtən ˈɹikæp baɪ təˈnaɪt/
dialogue.zh: 今晚我會寄一份文字摘要給你。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That'd be a lifesaver, thank you so much.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæd bi ə ˈlaɪfˌseɪvɚ θæŋk ju soʊ mʌtʃ/
dialogue.zh: 那可真是救了我，非常感謝。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: My pleasure, forty-two lunches, Friday, done.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ ˈplɛʃɚ ˈfɔɹti tu ˈlʌntʃəz ˈfɹaɪdeɪ dʌn/
dialogue.zh: 不客氣，四十二份午餐，週五，搞定。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: You made a stressful thing easy today.
dialogue.phonetic: /ju meɪd ə ˈstɹɛsfəl θɪŋ ˈizi təˈdeɪ/
dialogue.zh: 你今天讓這件麻煩事變得輕鬆多了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Anytime, good luck with the big meeting.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɛniˌtaɪm ɡʊd lʌk wɪð ðə bɪɡ ˈmitɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 舉手之勞，祝這場會議一切順利。

script.youtube_title: 【幫辦公室訂四十份午餐🍱】「有一半人不吃肉」🥗教你搞定外燴與過敏餐🥜｜聽完就能自己訂餐｜60句沉浸式英語聽力｜Office Catering Order
script.youtube_title_en: "Half of Them Don't Eat Meat" — Ordering Lunch Catering for the Office
script.youtube_description:
「有一半的人不吃肉」——要幫整個辦公室訂四十多份午餐，怎麼用英文跟外燴公司講好主菜、蔬食、過敏與送貨時間？這一集是 60 句沉浸式英語聽力練習，場景就在一次辦公室團體餐的預訂電話。

你會聽到：報出人數與場合、問自助餐方案附哪些、選主菜與沙拉；當有人不吃肉、不能吃堅果或麩質時怎麼換菜與標示過敏原；還包括送貨時段、誰來簽收、每位計價、帳單付款與最後的整份確認。

整段對話只用 A2 初級單字與短句，反覆出現美國人訂餐的真實語感：um、well、so、ha、hmm、oh。聽完你就會用：I'd like to order...、what does that come with?、can you deliver...?、what's the damage?

後半段是逐句聽力＋跟讀練習，請大聲跟著唸，讓舌頭先學會，腦袋自然就記住。

不用背，多聽就會用。每天一集，把英文聽成直覺。

#EnglishListening #ESL #LearnEnglish｜喜歡的話請按訂閱與小鈴鐺。
script.youtube_description_en:
"Half of them don't eat meat" — you must order forty-plus lunches for the whole office, so how do you sort mains, veggie trays, allergies and delivery timing with a catering company in English? This is a 60-line immersive English listening practice built around one office lunch booking call.

You will hear: giving the headcount and the occasion, asking what a buffet plan includes, and picking mains and salad; swapping dishes and labeling allergens when a guest skips meat, nuts or gluten; plus the delivery window, who signs for it, the price per head, billing by invoice, and a final recap of the whole order.

Everything stays in A2-level words, with the real phone texture Americans use: um, well, so, ha, hmm, oh. By the end you'll own phrases like I'd like to order..., what does that come with?, can you deliver...?, and what's the damage?

The back half is a line-by-line listen-and-repeat workout, so speak out loud and let your mouth learn first.

No memorizing needed — just listen often and it sticks.

#EnglishListening #ESL #LearnEnglish — subscribe for a new scene every day.
script.youtube_title_ref: 【🎬沉浸式英文動畫】🎧辦公室訂餐英文・蔬食拼盤與沙拉・過敏名單與送貨時段｜🌱A2 初級英文｜💡不用背，多聽就會用｜🎧聽力口說練習｜後段逐句跟讀
script.youtube_description_ref:
📌 影片簡介：
週五要替整個團隊訂午餐，四十幾號人，有人吃素、有人堅果過敏，該怎麼用一通電話把所有細節都講清楚？送貨時間又該怎麼配合會議？

這一集帶大家陪一位活動窗口致電外燴公司，從報人數、選主菜與蔬食、標示過敏原，一路聽到送貨時段、簽收、每位計價與帳單付款，共 60 句連續真實對話。

你會聽到：
🍱 開場句：Hi, I'd like to order lunch for our office.
🥗 換菜句：Well, half of them don't eat meat.
🥜 過敏句：One guest can't have any nuts at all.
💵 計價句：Let me run it, about twelve a head.

後半段是逐句聽力＋跟讀練習：每一句先聽兩遍，再跟著大聲說一遍，把 um、well、hmm、oh 這些自然語感唸進直覺裡。🎧

🌱 適合 A2 初級英文學習者：不用背單字、不用學文法，多聽就會用。跟著這通訂餐電話走一遍，下次要幫辦公室訂午餐，你就能從容問清楚。

祝你下次團隊聚餐，餐點剛剛好。
